Is your Klaviyo open rate too high? How to check segments considering Apple MPP

When sending emails internationally, you might find that despite high open rates, they don't lead to clicks or purchases. In such cases, before revising your subject lines or body content, try checking the segments based on email opens. It is possible that opens caused by Apple's Mail Privacy Protection (MPP) are being included in your target audience criteria.
What changes with MPP

In Apple email apps where MPP is enabled, images are pre-loaded regardless of whether the recipient has actually read the email. Since the images used for open tracking are also loaded, open events may be recorded in Klaviyo.

In Klaviyo, you can check this using the "Apple Privacy Open" open event. If it is True, it indicates an open in an environment where MPP is enabled, and it is impossible to distinguish whether the recipient actually read it. It is important not to treat True as "unread".
Checking with a comparison segment

First, check the segment you are currently using for "people who opened an email within a certain period" and create a copy for comparison. Avoid editing the original segment currently used in campaigns or flows on the spot.
